lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a dense, staggered grid posterior to the five gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima form four distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary rows of blobs, most notably in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a rectangular coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features are visible on the upper dorsal flank, showing a clear gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) at three distinct pixel coordinates: ventral to the jaw, dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion, and a cluster on the ventral midline.
